heading: Tuesday, December 9, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Zhipu AI AutoGLM and Mistral AI Devstral 2.

items.headline: Zhipu AI open-sources AutoGLM phone agent
items.summary: Zhipu open-sourced AutoGLM, an agent model and toolchain that operates Android phones by reading the screen and simulating taps, swipes and typing, including the AutoGLM-Phone-9B model. It supports multi-step tasks across more than 50 Chinese apps and can be deployed locally or in the cloud.

items.headline: Mistral releases Devstral 2 and Mistral Vibe CLI
items.summary: Devstral 2 is a 123B dense coding model with a 256K context released under a modified MIT license, alongside the 24B Devstral Small 2 under Apache 2.0 and the open-source Vibe CLI coding agent. Mistral reports 72.2% on SWE-bench Verified for Devstral 2 and 68.0% for Devstral Small 2.
